description: AgroVision AI 2.0 Adaptive Farmer Questionnaire Configuration defining conditional questions, symptom vocabularies, organ compatibilities, and evidence references.

questions.question_text: What visual symptoms do you observe on the affected plant?
questions.help_text: Select all visible abnormal patterns, discoloration, or structural changes.

allowed_options.label: Yellowing or Chlorosis
allowed_options.description: Leaves or veins turning pale or yellow

allowed_options.label: Brown or Black Spots / Lesions
allowed_options.description: Dark circular, angular, or irregular patches

allowed_options.label: White Powder-like Growth
allowed_options.description: White talcum-like fungal film on leaf surface

allowed_options.label: Water-soaked or Greasy Lesions
allowed_options.description: Dark translucent wet-looking patches often with yellow halo

allowed_options.label: Wilting or Drooping
allowed_options.description: Loss of turgidity despite moist soil

allowed_options.label: Chewed Holes or Insect Piercing
allowed_options.description: Physical puncture marks, webbing, or frass

allowed_options.label: Rot or Soft Decaying Tissue
allowed_options.description: Foul-smelling mushy or spongy decay

allowed_options.label: Mosaic or Mottled Leaf Pattern
allowed_options.description: Alternating dark green and yellow patchy patterns or leaf curling

allowed_options.label: Stunted Growth / Dwarfism
allowed_options.description: Severe reduction in plant height or internode shortening

allowed_options.label: Other Unlisted Symptom
allowed_options.description: Abnormal signs not covered by standard options

allowed_options.label: Not Sure / Unclear
allowed_options.description: Symptoms are difficult to discern

evidence_references: ICAR-ANGRAU Plant Pathology Diagnostic Field Manual 2024

questions.question_text: Where do the symptoms appear across the plant or field?
questions.help_text: Indicates whether the problem is localized, systemic, or field-wide.

allowed_options.label: One leaf or isolated plant part
allowed_options.description: Confined to a single branch, leaf, or fruit

allowed_options.label: Several parts of a single plant
allowed_options.description: Multiple leaves or organs on one plant are affected

allowed_options.label: Scattered cluster of plants
allowed_options.description: Appearing across multiple neighboring plants in patches

allowed_options.label: Widespread across most of the field
allowed_options.description: Generalized symptom throughout the entire crop stand

allowed_options.label: Not Sure
allowed_options.description: Field extent has not been surveyed

questions.question_text: When did you first notice these symptoms?
questions.help_text: Duration helps distinguish acute virulent infections from slow chronic stresses.

allowed_options.label: Within the last 1 to 3 days
allowed_options.description: Very recent acute onset

allowed_options.label: 4 to 7 days ago
allowed_options.description: Appeared approximately one week ago

allowed_options.label: 1 to 2 weeks ago
allowed_options.description: Ongoing for up to two weeks

allowed_options.label: More than 2 weeks ago
allowed_options.description: Long-standing or chronic symptom

allowed_options.label: Not Sure
allowed_options.description: Exact onset date is unknown

evidence_references: Agrios Plant Pathology 5th Edition (Etiology & Disease Progress)

questions.question_text: How quickly is the problem spreading?
questions.help_text: Differentiates rapid airborne/secondary spread from stationary abiotic issues.

allowed_options.label: Rapidly (multiplying daily)
allowed_options.description: New lesions or infected plants appearing continuously

allowed_options.label: Slowly (gradual progression)
allowed_options.description: Slowly expanding over days or weeks

allowed_options.label: Not spreading (stationary)
allowed_options.description: Existing spots remain same size without new infections

allowed_options.label: Not Sure
allowed_options.description: Spread rate has not been monitored

evidence_references: EPPO Plant Disease Spread Dynamics Guidance

questions.question_text: What is the current crop growth stage?
questions.help_text: Plant age strongly influences susceptibility to specific pathogens.

allowed_options.label: Seedling / Nursery Stage
allowed_options.description: Young shoots, cotyledons, or recent transplants

allowed_options.label: Vegetative Growth / Tillering
allowed_options.description: Active leaf, stem, or canopy expansion

allowed_options.label: Flowering / Panicle Emergence
allowed_options.description: Blossom or tassel development

allowed_options.label: Fruit Development / Pod / Grain Filling
allowed_options.description: Developing fruit, grain, or pod enlargement

allowed_options.label: Maturity / Ripening / Pre-Harvest
allowed_options.description: Color change, drying, or physiological maturity

allowed_options.label: Not Sure
allowed_options.description: Growth stage is not known

questions.question_text: What field or weather conditions occurred recently?
questions.help_text: High moisture and dew favor fungal sporulation; dry heat favors mites and viruses.

allowed_options.label: Heavy rain or thunderstorm
allowed_options.description: Substantial rainfall in the preceding 7 days

allowed_options.label: High humidity or persistent morning dew
allowed_options.description: Prolonged leaf wetness duration

allowed_options.label: Hot and dry conditions
allowed_options.description: Elevated ambient temperatures with low atmospheric moisture

allowed_options.label: Waterlogging or standing water
allowed_options.description: Soil saturated with poor root aeration

allowed_options.label: Recent heavy irrigation
allowed_options.description: Furrow or flood irrigation within last 48 hours

allowed_options.label: No unusual weather or conditions
allowed_options.description: Normal seasonal weather

allowed_options.label: Not Sure
allowed_options.description: Field conditions were not tracked

questions.question_text: Are pests or insects visible on or near the affected plant?
questions.help_text: Insect vectors like whiteflies and aphids transmit viral mosaic and curl diseases.

allowed_options.label: Yes (insects, caterpillars, aphids, or whiteflies seen)
allowed_options.description: Live insect activity detected

allowed_options.label: No (no visible insects)
allowed_options.description: Careful inspection revealed no live insects

allowed_options.label: Not Sure
allowed_options.description: Undersides of leaves were not checked

questions.question_text: Have you already applied any chemical or organic treatment?
questions.help_text: Prior pesticide sprays can alter symptom appearance or induce phytotoxicity.

allowed_options.label: Yes
allowed_options.description: A treatment was sprayed or applied

allowed_options.label: No
allowed_options.description: No chemical or biological product has been applied

questions.help_text: Enter the fungicide/insecticide name, organic spray, or dosage if known.
